info.title: API.SH: iHerb
info.description: The iHerb API from API.SH: public iHerb data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Route prefix, e.g. /tiktok/v1

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor from `next`.

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
The products of one iHerb category (e.g. vitamin-c, supplements) or brand page (e.g. california-gold-nutrition), 48 a page, with the same fields, filters and facets as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/iherb-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A category or brand slug, or an iherb.com/c/<slug> link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: featured (default), relevance, best_sellers, top_rated, most_rated, price_asc, price_desc, newest, heaviest, lightest, discount.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand codes from the brand facet, comma-separated.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Sub-category ids from the category facet, comma-separated.

parameters.name: health_topic
parameters.description: Health topic ids, comma-separated.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Attribute ids, comma-separated.

parameters.name: price_range
parameters.description: Price range ids from the price facet.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Minimum star rating, 1-5.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: true for products in stock only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One iHerb product: name, brand, part number, price, list price and discount, price per serving, special deals, stock (with back-in-stock date), rating with the 5-to-1 star breakdown, review count per language, the AI review summary, the top positive and top critical review, question and answer counts, description, suggested use, ingredients, warnings, supplement facts (text and table HTML), best-seller ranks per category, category paths, package quantity, weight, dimensions, expiration date, first available date, badges, warehouses and all images.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/iherb-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product number at the end of an iherb.com/pr/<name>/<id> link, or that link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer questions about one iHerb product with their answers (text, date, nickname, best-answer and verified-purchase flags, helpful votes), 10 a page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/iherb-questions

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product id or its iherb.com link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevant (default), newly_answered, helpful, newest, oldest.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only questions containing these words.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Reviews of one iHerb product: rating, title, text, date, language, reviewer country, nickname and profile, verified purchase, helpful votes and photos, with the site's sorts and filters (stars, photos only, words in the review, review language). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/iherb-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product id or its iherb.com link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevant (default), newest, helpful.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only these star ratings, comma-separated (e.g. 1,2).

parameters.name: images_only
parameters.description: true for reviews with photos only.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only reviews containing these words.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Review language code (default en-US; e.g. de-DE, ja-JP), or all for every language.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-50 (default 10).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
iHerb product search, 48 a page: product id, link, part number, name, brand and brand code, price, list price, discount, price per serving, rating and review count, stock, sponsored and trial flags, badge (Quality Pick, Best Seller...), promo code, recent sales and image. `facets` lists every filter section of the results (category, brand, rating, price, health topic, programs...) with each value's URL parameter, value and product count: pass the value in the matching parameter. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/iherb-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: featured (default), relevance, best_sellers, top_rated, most_rated, price_asc, price_desc, newest, heaviest, lightest, discount.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category ids from the category facet (cids), comma-separated.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand codes from the brand facet (bids), comma-separated, e.g. CGN.

parameters.name: health_topic
parameters.description: Health topic ids from the health_topic facet (htids).

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Attribute ids from the facets (avids), e.g. 63303 for FSA & HSA eligible.

parameters.name: price_range
parameters.description: Price range ids from the price facet (ranges).

parameters.name: programs
parameters.description: Program ids from the programs facet (specialtyFilters), e.g. 7 for iHerb brands.

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Minimum star rating, 1-5.

parameters.name: in_stock
parameters.description: true for products in stock only.

parameters.name: only_at_iherb
parameters.description: true for products sold only at iHerb.

parameters.name: itested
parameters.description: true for products tested in iHerb's lab only.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
